parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The student draws the line MR to mark the position of a plane mirror.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw a normal to this line that passes through its centre. Label the normal NL . Label the point at which NL crosses MR with the letter A .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Draw a line 8.0 cm long from A at an angle of incidence i = 30° to the normal, below MR and to the left of the normal. Label the end of this line B . [3]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student places a pin P 1 at point B . He places a second pin P 2 on line AB . Label a position X on line AB to show a suitable position for pin P 2 . [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) He views the images of pins P 1 and P 2 from the direction indicated by the eye in Fig. 3.1. He places two pins P 3 and P 4 , a suitable distance apart, so that pins P 3 and P 4 , and the images of P 2 and P 1 , all appear exactly one behind the other. The positions of P 3 and P 4 are shown in Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw the line joining the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Extend the line until it meets NL .
